description: Log the actual cost of an LLM call after execution. Call this after every LLM request to build calibration data that improves burnrate_estimate accuracy over time. Free — no credits charged. Returns the recorded cost entry with computed margin versus the prior estimate when one exists for this model and token range.

input_tokens.description: Actual prompt tokens used. Must be >= 0.

model.description: Model identifier as returned by the provider. Examples: claude-sonnet-4-6, gpt-4o, gemini-2.0-flash, mistral-large-latest. Unknown models are accepted but cost may show as $0.

output_tokens.description: Actual completion tokens used. Must be >= 0.

provider.description: LLM provider identifier. Supported: anthropic, openai, google, mistral, cohere, deepseek, together, fireworks, groq. Must match the provider of the model used.

task_id.description: Optional task ID for cross-referencing spend with DedupQ deduplication results. Use the same task_id passed to dedupq_check to link cost tracking with deduplication.

name: burnrate_track
